verdict.rationale: Sprinto ships its own AI features (the AI Editor and Sprinto AI evidence analysis), so asking whether customer data can be excluded from model training is a fair question for this product. The pack contains no documented training opt-out, no data-usage policy for its AI, and no setting that keeps customer data out of model training. Its AI governance and Shadow AI modules govern other AI tools an organisation uses, and that is an adjacent feature, not a control over Sprinto's own use of your data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
